title: Return credits keeps a chosen filter after a reload
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Parts in the top menu opens the parts area; its left menu lists Part Sales, Inventory, Catalog, Returns, Purchase Orders, Vendor Invoices, Vendors.
  • Needs no test data of its own beyond what the page already lists; filters you change here are restored at the end.

Setup

  1. Click Parts in the top menu > Returns > Credits tab. If Date is not "Date: 30 days", set it to 30 days.
  2. Check the setup worked: the Credits tab lists credits and the Date button reads "Date: 30 days".
custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Returns in the left menu.
  2. Click the Credits tab.
  3. Open the Date filter and pick a different value (e.g. 60 days). Write down the value.
  4. Close the filter (Escape or click outside it) and write down the rows shown.
  5. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After the reload the filter still shows the value you ticked and the same rows show as before the reload.
  • No error message appears.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): After the reload the page opens on the Returns tab, not Credits. Clicking Credits again shows the Date filter still on the value you picked and the same rows. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.
